mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 4.0% relative to its 5-year average signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate (UNRATE) increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) growth above their 6-month moving averages indicates robust consumer spending momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 6-month MA
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of joint growth instances, or interaction effect Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals manufacturing contraction that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle periods when INDPRO declines, or regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) acceleration exceeding 0.5 percentage points triggers expectations of aggressive Fed tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average indicates strong labor market conditions that support corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent real GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) expansion above their 6-month moving averages reflects broad-based economic momentum that generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both above 6-month MA
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of joint expansion instances, or interaction effect Rank IC falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals contractionary manufacturing activity that increases recession risk, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% and INDPRO declines, or regime-specific Rank IC is below 0.02.
